scope: Finite offer driver applies the existing application NSDP16 rule from real NWK state; pre-admitted fixed-route production NWK custody/HOP/MAC service with controlled successful addressed transport; excludes full application-generator parity, security admission, route convergence, RF collisions, half-duplex loss, PHY/ECC validation and stochastic population equivalence
precondition: Neighbor security admission and freshness disabled; real public neighbor/route APIs establish only the fixed chain before zero-time callbacks settle; no MAC timers or data are prewarmed
control_scope: Bootstrap routing controls are excluded from radio service: native propagation/snapshot response disabled, MATLAB CanSendControl false with retry/watchdog beyond horizon; retain and disclose per-implementation pending controls; no claim of equivalent control queues
transport: unconditional addressed frame ingress at source-computed TX end plus fixed propagation; no overhearing or transport-driven receiver state changes
offer_rule: At each integer20ms poll invoke node4 then5 once. If source has fewer case-defined apps admitted, emit offer; finite driver consults native CanAdmitApplicationPacket or MATLAB NWK applicationState.NsdpCount < NsdpLimit (assert limit16), then calls NWK application send. Blocked attempts retain candidate identity. No application offer from HOP wake; production HOP wake drives real NWK queue only. Full production ApplicationGenerator is not invoked.
application_id_rule: Per-source candidate IDs1..20; SourceId plus ID identifies one app. Generation time assigned only on successful NWK admission; relaying preserves source,ID,payload and generation time.
tape_rule: Exact support 0..31; exhaust fails; unused suffix recorded by node; MATLAB must match native consumed ordinal count, support and value

numeric_conventions.time_ns: round(time_seconds * 1e9); compare with at most 1 ns tolerance to native integer time, separately disclose any nonzero difference

radio_scope: Fixed128kbps/+33dBm; does not validate adaptive radio rate/power decisions
release_identity: app_source from real callback; app_id/hop_seq/bitmaps0; peer4->5 or5->1; observe after real NWK release callback before HOP resend removal
custody_scope: nwk_waiting counts only unsubmitted data; nwk_custody counts outstanding original plus relayed data awaiting release (MATLAB PendingCustody, native NSDP4+NSDP5); nsdp4/nsdp5 are row-node counts for source4/source5 to destination1. Excludes bootstrap control owners.
capacity_release_scope: Observe real DACK holds at16s with workload complete; continue unchanged production timers to final24s for DACK-expiry capacity release. At stable checkpoint/final snapshots HOP pending equals live resend owners plus actual DACK holds; release callbacks may observe intentional intermediate removal order.
